00-introduction.description: Top-level overview — no single source file; changes whenever any major subsystem changes

changelog.description: Reverse-chronological log of significant additions; updated manually with each feature sprint

backend/01-architecture.description: Backend layer diagram, DDD module structure, dual-DB pattern, DI wiring

backend/02-npc-system.description: NPC CRUD, team management, domain service, REST endpoints, NpcCreatureSlotSpec; NPC content globalization via ContentWorldId sentinel and M2010GlobalizeNpcContent; battle_trainer_id minting (M2012) + NPC battle-item use endpoint (use-battle-item)

backend/03-spawner-system.description: Weighted spawn pools, spawn history, spawner tables, SpawnerDefinition.battleArenaKey, Wild Trainer GUID integration; global read-only spawner template (per-trainer clones retired by M5016RetirePerTrainerSpawner), stateless spawning (no capacity/cooldown)

backend/04-creature-generation.description: Creature generation pipeline, growth profiles, abilities assignment, quest-gated ability unlocks

backend/05-starter-creature-flow.description: Starter creature selection and onboarding flow, end-to-end

backend/06-auth-and-accounts.description: Auth system: JWT, OAuth linking, account management

backend/07-quest-system.description: Quest system: templates, objectives, rewards, instances, progress events, requirements, condition evaluation

backend/08-stats-system.description: CR.Stats lifetime stat tracking domain: trainer_stat, stat_event, operators, StatKey constants

unity/01-project-setup.description: Unity project structure, packages, folder layout; two-database (game-data vs player-data) config keys and startup migration flow

unity/02-dependency-injection.description: Zenject DI patterns, WithId bindings, scene installers

unity/03-world-behaviours.description: IWorldInitializable, WorldRegistry, GameInitializer bootstrap, INpcSubInitializable composable NPC sub-behaviours

unity/04-npc-interaction.description: Composable NPC interaction: NpcInteractionBehaviour dispatch, NpcBattleRequest, OnBattleRequested event, grant vs battle vs merchant vs dialogue flow

unity/05-http-clients.description: Online/offline repository pattern, Best HTTP, ServerRequestException family + PlayerErrorText, SQLite cache

unity/06-localization.description: Per-domain per-language YAML localization files, LocalizationRepository loading, key naming convention

unity/07-battle-system.description: BattleCoordinator sequential turn loop with battle-scoped CancellationToken, BattleHttpDomainAdapter + OnlineOfflineBattleDomainService stack, BattleEvents static events (incl. StagingFailed), Arena system with IBattleStager returning BattleStagingResult (player teleport + creature visual spawn at PlayerCreaturePosition/OpponentCreaturePosition), self-registering BattleArenaRegistry, reactive Cinemachine 3 cinematic camera (BattleCinematicDirector conductor driven by CameraCue*/TurnStarted, editor-authored BattleCameraRig role vCams + BattleCameraProfile feel SO + decoupled BattleCameraShakeResponder via BattleCameraRigContext, BattleFormation slot model for 1v1->NvN, one-click rig builder + beat simulator), per-creature CreatureBattlePresenter (added to creature prefabs; the stager resolves the creature's shared CreatureReactionProfile from its CreatureDefinition by content key, flattens any base→variant inheritance via Resolve(), and hands the result to Bind; subscribes to BattleEvents and plays the creature's own body — animation+cry+feedback — per beat, with a standard Animator state-name convention in CreatureReactionDefaults and HasState-guarded fallbacks), ability VFX/SFX sourced from AbilityConfig keys on the outcome and played positionally by BattleAbilityFxResponder via a single positioned AbilityFxCue + BattleVisualRegistry (id→transform), BattleHUD with Guid-typed creature IDs and HP cache replay, BattleSync SOAP bridge, StartNpcBattle/StartWildBattle, NpcBattleRequest.BattleArenaKey, SpawnerEncounterBehaviour with encounter delay; trainer battles: bark-then-challenge flow (TrainerChallenged banner, Run hidden, RunRefused log, OpponentItemUsed), shared RunTurnLoopAsync with trainer AI decider + NPC item turns, TrainerBattleDefinition SO + Trainer Battle Author window (spawner plumbing hidden, deterministic md5 ids, bark conversation + scene stamp); Trainer Battle Author rebuilt as the project's first UXML/USS editor window (roster rail + dossier, readiness meter, checklist cards, plain-language copy); dev-only BattleDebugStatsOverlay (F3, Editor/DEVELOPMENT_BUILD only) rendering per-creature stat/status/ability/held-item/stat-modifier panels beside BattleHUD's cards, sourced from the same BattleEvents bus + TeamSync

unity/16-domain-sync-pattern.description: IDomainSync pattern: BattleSync (SOAP bridge via events), TeamSync (world-scoped team cache), InventorySync (world-scoped backpack cache), Zenject bindings; cache-first policy: content (pickup/achievement defs, quest templates) local-first with server on content_key miss, terminal player state (collected pickups, unlocks, completed quests, trainer defeats) local-first with session-once server reconcile, in-progress state server-when-online

unity/08-content-registry.description: IGameContentRegistry, ScriptableObjectContentRegistry, ServerContentRegistry, MutableContentRegistry, ContentRegistryInitializer, ContentManifestClientUnityHttp, ContentDefinitionProvider, ContentKeys constants, CreatureDefinition/ItemDefinition/NpcDefinition/SpawnerDefinition ScriptableObjects, CreatureContentDef/ItemContentDef/NpcContentDef/SpawnerContentDef POCOs, IGameAssetLoader.LoadAssetByKeyAsync, ContentStudioTool unified EditorWindow (7 tabs replacing ContentCreatorTool and AbilityLibraryTool), custom Inspectors for all definition types, AddressablesCatalogUpdater, LocalizationEditorWindow, ContentAuditTool, ContentPublishTool, AbilityConfig/AbilityProgressionSetConfig/GrowthProfileConfig SOs, AbilityEditorSyncHelper, ability sync clients (HTTP/local/online-offline); Content Studio chrome rebuilt in UI Toolkit (CRStudio.uss shared editor design system, grouped navigation rail with live counts, header count chips + server field + connection pill, status bar; tab bodies remain IMGUI in an IMGUIContainer); ContentDisplayName single naming rule + ContentPicker dropdowns (human names stored as keys, dangling references warned, options from project incl. arenas unioned from spawners/trainers/open scenes); header rebuilt around one StudioWorkSummary pill (the single ranked answer to "what needs doing", with the button that resolves it) plus Guide and Advanced switches — Advanced (same pref as the old Debug toggle) holds the server field, raw keys/ids, the all-content sync bar and the recovery actions; ContentSectionCatalog is the one source of the rail's labels, groups and per-section guide sentences; project scans (registry sweep, orphan scan, Addressables lookups, push-state file stats) cached through EditorMemo/EditorMemoPolicy on the IMGUI layout pass instead of running every repaint; Trainer Battles tab; spawner/pool/creature/item reference fields all ContentPicker dropdowns (Fetch-button flows deleted); NpcAuthorChecklist readiness panel on NpcDefinitionEditor; Content Studio's slow work moved off the draw thread into a job system (StudioJobTracker/StudioJobQueue pure logic + StudioJob/StudioIteratorJob/StudioJobRunner stepping on EditorApplication.update within an 8ms budget, yield-a-Task for non-Unity work, StudioProgressBar cr-jobbar strip above the status bar, [Studio]-prefixed console lines on every status transition): per-definition content pushes (plan built without network, one send per tick, cancellable, tab not stamped on a partial run), per-type pulls, and the registry sweep + push comparison (published into a pending slot and adopted only on a Layout pass); NPC placements now scanned across EVERY scene in the project rather than the open ones — NpcSceneScanJob reads scene/prefab YAML on a worker thread (NpcScanFileReader buffered single-pass pre-filter, NpcScenePlacementParser for Component/PrefabInstance/PrefabReference shapes, NpcPrefabClosure fixed point over m_SourcePrefab so variants and nested NPC prefabs count), results cached per file in Library/CRStudioNpcScenes.json under NpcScanCachePolicy with prefab-state and resolved-prefab fingerprints; NpcPlacementIndex/NpcSceneGroup drive a scan strip, per-row 'in Village (2), Meadow' summaries and per-scene grouped placements with Open scene/Select via NpcPlacementNavigator; NpcDefinitionEditor's checklist reads placement from the scan or the open scene and memoises BuildSnapshot; LIVE OPS group (Players tab 18 + Marketplace tab 19 in Editor/LiveOps/, EditorAdminAuth admin token, StudioJob-backed admin reads/writes, ModerationReasonDialog) — see backend/18-moderation; Review window (ContentReviewWindow, Review button beside Push All): every unpushed asset grouped by type with per-row Diff (FieldDiff over EditorJsonUtility of local vs server-applied clone), Push (PushOne, single-asset job, tab not stamped) and Revert (RevertOne, same apply as Pull All, confirm-gated, not for Trainer Battles); ContentPushLog per-asset stamps (LastPushUtcTicks_asset_<guid>) so ContentPushStatus counts an asset pushed when newer than the later of tab/asset stamps; ReviewRow/ReviewGroup/ContentReviewRows pure logic

backend/10-asset-management.description: game_assets table, app_config singleton row, version-check endpoint, content-publish endpoint, content-manifest endpoint, X-Pipeline-Key auth, three-system asset architecture (Addressables CDN, cr-api backend, local SQLite), S3/MinIO CDN setup, deploy scripts

backend/11-item-spawner.description: Item spawner mirroring the creature spawner: item_spawner/_pool/_template tables (M6010–M6012), weighted roll (pool by weight×rarity, template by probability, guaranteed at p=1.0), NpcMerchantService.StockFromSpawnerAsync into npc_inventory, sync-config + roll + stock-from-spawner endpoints, ItemSpawnerDefinition authoring + NpcDefinition.itemSpawnerContentKey

backend/12-trainer-currency.description: Trainer currency: trainers.currency (M4012, default 500), race-safe TryAdjustCurrency conditional UPDATE, merchant purchase debit / sell credit inside the transaction, QuestRewardType.Currency payout, no client adjust endpoint by design

unity/09-addressables-setup.description: Unity Addressables end-to-end setup: Groups/Profiles windows, Play Mode Script, making assets Addressable, ContentPublishTool Seed to SQLite, Deploy Content tool, MinIO/S3 gotchas, CreatureSpawner MonoBehaviour; baked game-data.bytes artifact shipped as Addressable + StreamingAssets (CR.Data.Migrations.Tool + build-packages.sh)

unity/10-player-menu-ui.description: Player menu UI: 5-tab overlay (Team/Bag/Quests/Journal/System) wired to real domain data — PlayerTeamView squad sheet, BagScreenHandler backpack with BagItemPolicy filtering, QuestJournalView active/completed quests, JournalView achievements + stat records, CR.UI.Logic pure rules, input wiring via UICoordinator

backend/09-battle-persistence.description: Battle DB tables (battle with active creature IDs, battle_round, battle_round_input, battle_action_log), persistent HP/conditions on generated_creature_current_stats + generated_creature_status_conditions, IBattleRepository, IGeneratedCreatureRepository, BattleDomainService, BattleHttpDomainAdapter, REST endpoints, DI wiring, ability progression, animation_key + VFX/SFX keys on abilities; trainer battles (battle_type Wild/Trainer, minted battle trainer via npcs.battle_trainer_id, run refused without turn cost, heal-on-start, 1.5x XP / 2x currency, TrainerBattleAIDomainService swap→heal→attack, opponent_content_key M8017, M10020 Meadow demo trainer); elemental reactions as authored content (elemental_reaction table M12006, IElementalReactionRepository, /api/v1/elemental-reactions, resolver injection + ActionOutcome.ReactionLogLine) and the versioned elemental_damage matrix (/api/v1/elemental-damage, active-version pointer honoured with a has-rows fallback, M12007 Radiant self-multiplier fix + DECIMAL(4,2) widening)

unity/11-dialogue-integration.description: Dialogue System abstraction: IDialogueHandler interface, PixelCrushersDialogueHandler MonoBehaviour, QuestDialogueBridge, NpcDialogueBehaviour interact-driven conversation start (replaces ProximitySelector use-key), conversation dropdown in QuestObjectiveDefinition editor, abort-detection flag pattern

unity/12-scriptable-objects.description: All ScriptableObject types: what each does, every field, which sync to the backend and via which endpoint, ContentDefinitionProvider registry wiring, BattleCameraProfile cinematic-camera feel SO, CreatureReactionProfile shared body-reaction SO (animation+cry+feedback per beat, baseProfile inheritance/override for evolutions, Resolve() flatten; referenced by CreatureDefinition.reactionProfile; offensive VFX comes from AbilityConfig), Dialogue Database note, ElementalReactionDefinition (primer condition + detonator element -> multiplier/applied condition, snake_case content key, seed-migration export) and ElementalDamageMatrixConfig (one asset per matrix version, 100 completed cells, isActive mirrors battle_system_version)

unity/13-battle-bag-ui.description: BattleBagPanelHandler item display logic, item row rendering, capture crystal visual indicators, BattleHUD integration, ItemUsageFlags/CaptureCrystal flag, USS styles for capture items

unity/14-capture-mechanic.description: Capture crystal tiers (Shard/Standard/Fine/Radiant), capture formula, capture_modifier property, Backend IItemEffectHandler wiring, BattleEvents.RaiseCreatureCaptured, USS visual indicators; shared CaptureChanceCalculator + OfflineItemUseService capture mirror + opponent-id resolution from battle record

unity/15-event-wiring.description: Designer-facing event + variable wiring: EventWiringManifest, VariableWiringManifest, IEventSourceRegistry, BattleEventsAdapter, TrainerSessionAdapter, QuestRewardAdapter, capture/exp/level events, editor window, codegen for IL2CPP, how to add new events and data payloads

unity/17-content-pipeline.description: Two-database content pipeline: game-data DB (global authored content, read-only) vs player-data DB (per-trainer saves, mutable); build-time game-data.bytes artifact from CR.Data.Migrations.Tool + build-packages.sh with 12 referential-integrity checks; ships as Addressable + StreamingAssets first-run floor; cold-start adopt (atomic copy + fail-closed schema-version gate); content patched via Addressables, player-data migrated in place; content-vs-player taxonomy

unity/18-merchant-shop.description: Player-facing merchant shop UI: NpcInteractionBehaviour merchant branch, MerchantShopScreenHandler (stock list, live prices, wallet, qty stepper, buy via PurchaseItemFromMerchantAsync), isMenuOpen input lock, sell tab stub

backend/13-loot-system.description: Battle-victory loot: layered spawner+creature loot tables, independent per-entry drop chance, LootRollService, RewardGrantService, LootAward on the battle outcome, M7100-M7103 + M8016 spawner linkage, BattleRewardScaling level-scaled victory currency and XP; Npc owner type (LootOwnerType.Npc) unioned via battle.opponent_content_key for trainer-battle drops

backend/14-world-pickups.description: World pickups: pickup_definition (rewards JSON) + pickup_collected (per-trainer, revive-on-write upsert), one-time persistent grants, consumer-routed Quest rewards, M7200-M7202

backend/15-achievements.description: Achievements: achievement_definition + achievement_reward (child) content + achievement_unlocked (per-trainer, did-I-win-the-insert upsert), Stats-driven threshold eval rides the quest funnel via optional IAchievementDomainService, QuestProgressResult.NewlyUnlocked, M7300-M7303 + M9993 content bump; Unity toast + LocationTriggerBehaviour

unity/19-account-mode-startup.description: Mode-gated account/startup: one device-bound account, boot-time EnsureLocalAccountAsync (mode-neutral) so an account always exists, mode-first menu (Continue/Play Online/Play Offline) via the existing MainMenuController (IUIScreen 'MainMenu'), connectivity-gated online entry via IConnectivityProbe (reuses version-check), no reconciliation between offline/online worlds, characters mode-locked via IsOnlineTrainer; supporting fixes: ByteArrayTypeHandler + M0008NormalizeEmptySalt for legacy salt rows, NpcMerchantService NotifyBackpackChanged post-commit so InventorySync refreshes

unity/20-ability-workbench.description: Ability Workbench editor tooling: readiness strip, FX library picker, one-click Publish pipeline, edit-mode FX preview, FX templates, Studio chips and Ability FX audit checks, FX seed migration exporter (M9997 authoritative snapshot) + one-click floor rebake / full package rebuild menu items; Pipeline CLI commands (cr_fx_seed_status / cr_export_fx_seeds / cr_rebake_floor) and the async EditMode test runner (cr_edit_tests_start / cr_edit_tests_status).

unity/21-standalone-builds.description: Standalone desktop builds: Unity 6 build profiles (CR_Game_macOS / CR_Game_Windows / CR_Game_Linux_SteamDeck, BuildProfileSetupTool reflection factory), CR > Build > Build Players… sequential multi-target window (PlayerBuildPlan pure logic + tests), per-platform e_sqlite3 natives bundled by build-packages.sh, Addressables built with player, game-data.bytes floor, Mono-only Windows cross-build; CR > Build > Deploy to Steam Deck… one-step Linux build + rsync-over-SSH push to a fixed folder on the Deck (SteamDeckDeployPlan pure logic + tests)

22-area-scenes.description: Core + additive area scenes, the area template, content prefabs, doors and async transitions; trainer last-location persistence (M4013 last_area_key/pos/yaw, TrainerLocationTracker throttled saves + forced on switch/quit, TrainerResumeRule teleport/transition resume) and trainer-switch world re-init (AreaWorldInitializer.ResetForNewSession)

23-game-audio.description: IGameAudio seam over Master Audio, mixer buses, per-area music/ambience with transition rules, menu sound keys, and the Unity 6 vendor patch

unity/24-battle-extensions.description: Battle-extension sidecar pattern: the two seams (BattleEvents.ActionResolved outbound, IPlayerAbilityAugmenter inbound via [InjectOptional]), why the battle system is unmodified (no ability-ownership check in BattleDomainService), and battle missions as the worked example — pure per-battle BattleMissionTracker in CR.Game.Battle.Logic (11 EditMode tests), BattleMissionConductor (reward resolution via IAbilityDomainService, MissionProgressed/MissionCompleted, battle_missions_completed stat), battle_mission_template content (M10004 + M10003 Mega Burn) served by GET /api/v1/battle-missions and routed through SyncRouter, HUD toast/banner/UNLOCKED badge

unity/25-player-character.description: Player character: BoZo modular body retargeted onto the Malbers AC Human v5 controller via Humanoid avatars, bone re-homing by HumanBodyBones, cr_build_player_model and cr_swap_player_in_scene

unity/27-content-sync.description: Runtime content pull-through cache: ServerContentSyncService fetch+paging, ContentSyncWriter SQL rules (no id rewrites, lowercase GUIDs, named-column upserts, derived junction ids, per-domain transactions), ContentSyncReport version-recording rule, deletion safety, and the dotnet round-trip tests.

unity/26-creature-storage.description: Creature storage tab: engine-free box/filter/swap rules in CR.UI.Storage.Logic, the Data File ability roster (learned / level-locked / quest-locked), the quest-gate authoring field and its sync-column parity, and the atomic team<->storage exchange

backend/16-evolution.description: Rule-based server-authoritative evolution: requirement groups, the pure evaluator and facts builder, level-up and item-use triggers, consumption at Commit, hold-to-cancel, the Bindstone, and the seeded lines

backend/17-creature-market.description: Player-to-player creature marketplace: market_listing/market_transaction, the escrow trainer, the transfer core (list/buy/cancel), and MarketListingView browse joins

backend/18-moderation.description: Live-ops moderation: account_moderation/admin_action, shadow bans and the hidden-seller rule, player dossiers, currency/item adjustments, and the /api/v1/admin routes behind RequireAdmin

unity/28-creature-market.description: Player-facing marketplace window: Browse/Sell/My Listings tabs, the advanced growth-value search panel, the market broker NPC branch, CR.UI.Market.Logic pure rules (fee math, filters, sorting, eligibility, growth summary, error text), and the offline-closed behaviour

backend/19-item-effects.description: Item use end to end: the item table (incl. icon_asset_key), ItemType/ItemUsageFlags/ItemEffectType, ItemUseDomainService's ordered checks and each handler's refusal sentence, the offline mirror's divergences (BoostStatTemp no-op, TriggerEvolution allowed offline, CureAllStatus refusal, missing stats/quest events), the 15 seeded creature consumables from M6020, the status-condition catalogue and its M12011 ability hooks, and GET /api/v1/trainers/{trainerId}/creatures/{creatureId}/status-conditions with its 401/404 semantics and the parked caller-to-trainer binding

unity/29-ui-icons.description: One content-icon system: icon_asset_key on item/creature/abilities/status_conditions, IconAddress (icons/<type>/<key>) kept separate from the prefab asset_key, IconGlyph two-letter placeholder, UiIcon.Apply as the single LoadAssetByKeyAsync<Sprite> caller (per-element cancellation, ConditionalWeakTable, Debug-only failure logging) plus UiIcon.uss, the icon/iconKey pair on four SO types drawn by IconSlotField, cr_import_icons + icon-map.json + the three Asset Store packs, cr_bake_portraits with blank/OPAQUE detection, IconImportReport buckets, and how icon keys ride the Content Studio push/pull merge

unity/30-evolution-authoring.description: Authoring evolution rules on CreatureDefinition, the inspector section and its validation, Content Studio push/pull/revert/diff, the M12019 seed export and floor rebake, runtime rule sync
